name: r5-karlore-plug
description: THE HEADLINE PAIR, arm 1 of 2 — `fire` WITHHELD. Identical to `r5-karlore-fire` in every field but `grants` — the plan is the FIRE arm's, and this arm simply runs it without the item. `Karlore.added()` removes himself only `if (Player.hasFire)`, so with the boolean false the NPC is built, `NPC`'s constructor gives him `type = "Solid"` and his own `setHitbox(16,16,8,8)` fills tile (7,17) — and a flood from the arrival reaches TWO tiles with him there against 138 without. The walk PINS with its box top flush against y = 288. Without this arm, "the fire arm walked north" is not evidence that anything was ever in the way.
